name: OmaSyncthing
author: Ninepoint Labs
description: Syncthing folders, devices, transfer rates and pending invites in the Omarchy bar, with start/stop control of the syncthing user service.

barWidget.description: Start and stop Syncthing, watch folders sync, pause folders and devices, and accept incoming share invites.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the full status is re-read. Syncthing's own event stream already pushes changes as they happen, so this is only a backstop.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Announce devices connecting and disconnecting, folders finishing or failing, and incoming device and folder invites.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: none: the icon only. rate: current transfer speed. percent: overall sync completion, hidden at 100%. devices: connected out of total. Always hidden on a vertical bar.
